import json, sys, glob
tid = sys.argv[1]
f = glob.glob(f"{tid}__*.json")[0]
d = json.load(open(f))
print("=== TASK", tid, "SCORE", d['score']['reward'])
print("FEEDBACK:", d['score']['feedback'])
print("INSTR:", d['input']['instruction'])
print("POS:", d['input']['answer_position'], "| TYPE:", d['input']['instruction_type'])
print("=== TRACE (role: content) ===")
for m in d['rollout']['trace']:
    role = m.get('role')
    c = m.get('content')
    if isinstance(c, list):
        c = "\n".join(str(p) for p in c)
    print(f"\n----- {role} -----")
    print(str(c)[:3000])
